scope: Vanilla/Classic only; excludes TBC/Wrath and unreleased custom dungeons
intendedConsumer: DBM-CoA encounter discovery, boss attribution and encounter-completion matching
sourceStatus: Pending SQL and map-scoped health crosswalk; NOT confirmed deployed live
usageRules: Use mapId + npcId + encounterId as research candidates; validate against actual game client and live logs before enabling boss warnings
Dungeon map joins are inferred from map-scoped health NPC records; verify collisions and 41 unmatched records separately
Raid difficulty codes copied from source comments; verify client DBC before assuming modes
lastEncounterLfgId is LfgDungeon.dbc ID, NOT map ID
creditType 0 indicates NPC kill credit; do not assume all encounters use that type
Do not create timers from encounter credit rows; mechanics and cast observations are separate evidence
Do not trigger warnings for player or pet abilities
